implemented_requirements.evidence: dice.py defines class Dice with roll(), last_total and last_is_doubles properties. Game.take_turn uses Dice.roll() and checks dice.last_is_doubles.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player movement around a 24‑space board, including GO salary collection
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._move_player and Game._move_to handle stepwise movement, wrap‑around, and add GO_SALARY when passing GO. Board.SIZE = 24.
Board defines Property objects with owner field. Game._offer_purchase prompts the player, charges money, calls player.add_property(prop) and sets prop.owner.
Game._resolve_property calls Property.calculate_rent (doubles rent on monopoly) and then Game._charge to transfer rent to the owner.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Chance cards with various effects (money, move, jail, collect/pay each, per‑property payment)
implemented_requirements.evidence: chance.py defines a deck of ChanceCard objects. Game._resolve_chance implements all EFFECT_* branches handling money, movement, jail, get‑out‑of‑jail, collect/pay each, and per‑property payment.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Tracking player money, net worth and bankruptcy
implemented_requirements.evidence: player.py defines money, receive(), pay(), net_worth() and bankrupt flag. Game._charge and Game._declare_bankrupt update these fields.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display of game status and prompts for player decisions
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.display_status prints each player's cash, location and properties. Game._prompt and Game._pause are used for purchase decisions, jail options, and dice rolls.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Jail rules (go to jail, paying fine, using Get Out of Jail card, rolling doubles, max turns)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board includes JailSpace and GoToJailSpace. Game._send_to_jail, Game._handle_jail_turn, and related constants implement fine payment, card usage, double rolls, and MAX_JAIL_TURNS.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Free Parking pot that accumulates from taxes and fines and is awarded to the landing player
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._charge with to_pot=True adds money to self.pot. Game._resolve_space for free_parking awards the pot to the player.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Entry point that collects player names and starts the game
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py defines collect_player_names() with CLI, interactive, and default fallback, then creates Game and calls play().

critical_issues: game.py does not import the Player class, causing a NameError when Game.__init__ tries to instantiate players.
Because of the missing import, the program cannot be executed without modification.
judge.summary: The repository contains a fairly complete implementation of the requested simplified Monopoly Go! features: dice rolling, board movement, property purchase, rent, chance cards, money tracking, jail mechanics, and a Free Parking pot. All core gameplay logic is present and well‑structured. However, a critical bug—missing import of the Player class in game.py—prevents the code from running, which lowers the executable likelihood and results in a failing overall verdict.
